meta.name: app-store-changelog
meta.description: Create user-facing App Store release notes by collecting and summarizing all user-impacting changes since the last git tag (or a specified ref). Use when asked to generate a comprehensive release changelog, App Store "What's New" text, or release notes based on git history or tags.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从git历史自动生成App Store发布说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动整理用户可见的变更记录
copy.tagline_en: Generate App Store release notes from git history automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually compile user-facing changes for each release

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据 Git 提交记录，自动生成面向用户的 App Store 发布说明。它会收集自上一个标签以来的变更，筛选出用户可见的改进，并按“新功能”“改进”“修复”分类，输出简洁的要点列表。
howto.when: 当你要求生成 App Store 发布说明、更新日志或“What's New”文本时触发。通常基于 Git 标签或指定版本范围。

say.text: 帮我生成 App Store 的发布说明，基于最近一次标签。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本收集变更并生成要点。

say.text: 生成 v1.2.3 到 HEAD 的更新日志。
say.note: 指定版本范围，Claude 会使用该区间。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate user-facing App Store release notes from git history. It collects changes since the last tag, filters user-visible ones, groups them by New/Improved/Fixed, and outputs concise bullet points.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to generate App Store release notes, changelog, or "What's New" text, typically based on git tags or a specified ref range.

say_en.text: Generate App Store release notes based on the latest tag.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script and produces bullet points.

say_en.text: Create a changelog from v1.2.3 to HEAD.
say_en.note: Specifies the version range for collection.
